title: Hondo Ohnaka
description: Legendary Outer Rim pirate Hondo Ohnaka was busy during the Clone Wars. He captured Count Dooku, Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi and tried to ramson then. Hondo put profit about all else, but also made enemies of truly evil people, like General Grievous and Darth Maul. After the Clone Wars, he ran Ohnaka Transport Solutions at Black Spire outpost.
